aomNorseGeneralRumor0.text: I hear that in some giant's cave lies a stone heart that is still hot, and whoever takes it has to carry it all the way back to a Norse town.

aomNorseGeneralRumor1.text: They say a man touched by a Frost Giant turns into an icicle and cannot move for a good while.

aomNorseGeneralRumor2.text: Fire Giants never come close; they just hurl balls of fire that set a whole patch ablaze.

aomNorseGeneralRumor3.text: Some say arrows bounce off Rock Giants, and only blades and axes can cut them.

aomNorseGeneralRumor4.text: I hear that when a Mountain Giant's club comes down, the thickest armor is like paper.

aomNorseGeneralRumor5.text: The Norse battering ram is just two dwarves running with a big log; once they reach the wall they can ram it.

aomNorseGeneralRumor6.text: I once saw a raven land on a dwarf's shoulder; the dwarf said it watches the battlefield for Odin.

aomNorseGeneralRumor7.text: Sailors say there is a kind of Kraken in the northern seas that can drag a whole ship under.

aomNorseGeneralRumor8.text: They say the Norse call their towns Althing, with longhouse after longhouse inside.

aomNorseGeneralRumor9.text: What Norse heroes fear most is having no war to fight: souls can only be stored on the battlefield.
